npcs.name: Major Cassian Vorn
npcs.status: Not physically present — last remote contact during the post-Vannix debrief; expected to make contact again.
npcs.summary: The Imperial officer holding coercive authority over the party's collars and running the mission's clean-up operation.
npcs.whatPartyKnows: Assigned Mission 02 as a hard, non-negotiable order. Assumes the party still has evidence from Vannix and said he'd revisit that matter "later, and less politely." Controls the collars and holds classified mission credentials.

npcs.name: Colonel Doran Rennick
npcs.role: Imperial Army Garrison Commander, Cathal's Reach
npcs.status: Present at the garrison — not yet directly encountered by the party.
npcs.summary: The party's Mission 02 target: a weathered garrison commander known for calm, dry humor, and genuine care for his soldiers.
npcs.whatPartyKnows: Known so far only through the mission briefing as the assigned target. Reputation from the briefing: after a rebel ambush killed several of his soldiers, he refused a doctrinal reprisal massacre and personally hunted the responsible cell instead, leaving the town standing — something Command apparently read as disobedience.

npcs.name: Captain Ilse Wove
npcs.summary: Rennick's fiercely loyal second — watchful, blunt, and unimpressed by outsiders.

npcs.name: Master Sergeant Bant Corrl
npcs.status: Present — met at the Redfall cantina; disposition currently uncertain.
npcs.summary: Warm, loud, and beloved by his troops — runs the cantina culture and knows every soldier by name.
npcs.whatPartyKnows: Was warmly charmed by Eleena at the cantina, then snapped into wary soldier's instinct the moment Imperial ID-sweep officers entered. Hasn't acted for or against the party yet — could vouch for them or stay silent and watch.

npcs.name: ID-Sweep Officer (1)
npcs.status: Present at the Redfall cantina — distracted, hasn't reported in.
npcs.summary: Conducting a routine ID/permit sweep; flagged Eleena's forged permits as inconsistent with the spaceport manifest.
npcs.whatPartyKnows: Was reaching for his comlink to report the discrepancy when Kenno's drunken stagger interrupted him.

npcs.name: ID-Sweep Officer (2)
npcs.status: Present at the Redfall cantina — watching Vesh.
npcs.summary: Partnered with the first sweep officer on the cantina check.
npcs.whatPartyKnows: Fixed his attention on Vesh after catching him leaning in too close to Eleena and Corrl's conversation. Hasn't acted yet.

npcs.summary: A homesteader whose family Rennick's troops protected instead of executing during the reprisal order.
